purpose: Prospectively validate that the native downstream midpoint answer-margin JVP generates grouped-MLP6--7 absolute causal amplitudes on new nouns and unseen above/below constructions.
data_status: NEW_TEXT; native capability opens first; immutable JVP prediction receipt must exist before any causal intervention outcome is evaluated

authority.novelty: Thirty-two noun forms are disjoint from prior Task14 authorities; all 96 prompts are unique; above_below and below_above are new registered templates.

binding_parent.finding: Retrospective midpoint JVP generated 80 frozen amplitudes at cosine 0.999999992 and relative L2 error 0.000140.

novelty_audit: Searches for prospective JVP amplitude, sealed downstream-gradient prediction, and prediction-before-causal validation found no prior authority event.
The parent diagnostic used already-open causal targets. This candidate enforces temporal separation: prediction artifact first, causal outcomes second.

stages.native_capability: All 12 direction-by-template-by-role cells must reach at least 0.75 accuracy before either prediction or causal validation.
stages.sealed_prediction: For each row and background in {empty, EAUW}, compute base/exact grouped-X head endpoints and the midpoint native-tail answer-margin gradient; write 64 predicted q values plus base-gradient controls. No intervention outcome is evaluated or read.
stages.causal_validation: Only after binding the prediction receipt hash, install base/exact heads, measure 64 exact-minus-base q values, and score the frozen predictions without refitting or rescaling.

predictions.pred_a_instrument_and_temporal_seal: Authority/capability/prediction hashes match; prediction receipt predates causal result; all numerical closures are at most 5e-5; exactly 64 unique predictions and targets exist.
predictions.pred_b_prospective_amplitude_generation: Overall midpoint cosine is at least 0.999, relative L2 error at most 0.01, and sign agreement is 1.0.
predictions.pred_c_direction_and_template_transfer: Each of four direction-by-template cells has midpoint cosine at least 0.995, relative L2 error at most 0.03, and sign agreement at least 0.9375.
predictions.pred_d_background_transfer: Empty and EAUW separately each have midpoint cosine at least 0.995 and relative L2 error at most 0.03.
predictions.pred_e_midpoint_beats_base_gradient: Midpoint relative L2 error is at least 50% lower than the frozen base-gradient prediction.
predictions.pred_f_no_lookup_or_scale_fit: The scorer uses no fitted scale, offset, target endpoint, or direction/template mean; descriptive best affine repair is reported only after literal gates and cannot change them.

null: Any failure of b-d rejects prospective amplitude generation on the new construction and preserves target endpoint calibration. Failure of e retains a prospective endpoint-gradient generator but rejects the midpoint-specific claim. Native-capability failure terminates before causal outcomes. No post-outcome rescaling may rescue a gate.
